d: Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
Are you a digitally driven marketing professional with a passion for creating impactful campaigns, building brand engagement, and delivering measurable business results?
We are currently looking for an experienced and innovative Digital Marketing Manager to join our team in Dubai.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies that strengthen brand presence, enhance customer engagement, drive lead generation, and maximize marketing performance. You will play a key role in shaping the digital customer journey through creative campaigns, data-driven insights, and emerging digital technologies.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, combine creativity with analytical thinking, and are passionate about delivering exceptional digital experiences, we would love to hear from you!

r: Digital Marketing Strategy: Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, website traffic, and lead generation.
Website Management & Optimization: Oversee website content, functionality, mobile responsiveness, user experience, and landing page optimization to improve customer journeys and conversions.
SEO & SEM: Drive search engine optimization, paid search, and digital advertising initiatives to improve online visibility and campaign performance.
Social Media Management: Develop and execute engaging social media strategies, manage content calendars, monitor audience engagement, and strengthen brand advocacy across digital platforms.
Paid Media & Budget Management: Plan, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns, ensuring effective budget allocation, improved conversion rates, and maximum return on investment.

Performance Analytics & Reporting: Utilize Google Analytics and other digital marketing tools to monitor website performance, campaign effectiveness, customer behavior, and key performance indicators.
Content & Digital Campaigns: Collaborate with creative teams and external agencies to develop compelling digital content, video campaigns, online promotions, and targeted email marketing initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, sales, aftersales, and external agencies to deliver integrated campaigns aligned with business objectives.
